<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\UserCategory;
use Illuminate\Auth\Events\Registered;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class RegisteredUserController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display the registration view.
     */
    public function create(): View
    {
        return view('auth.register');
    }

    /**
     * Handle an incoming registration request.
     *
     * @throws \Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException
     */
    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'firstname' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'lastname' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'email' => ['required', 'string', 'email', 'max:255', 'unique:'.User::class],
            'city' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'zip_code' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'address' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'province' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'user_type' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'company_name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'phone' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'vat_number' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'password' => ['required', 'confirmed', Password::defaults()],
        ], [], [
            'firstname' => __('validation.attributes.first_name'),
            'lastname' => __('validation.attributes.last_name'),
            'zip_code' => __('Zip / Postal Code'),
            'province' => __('validation.attributes.province'),
            'user_type' => __('form.label_user_type'),
            'vat_number' => __('VAT Number'),
        ]);

        $user = User::create([
            'firstname' => $request->firstname,
            'lastname' => $request->lastname,
            'email' => $request->email,
            'city' => $request->city,
            'zip_code' => $request->zip_code,
            'address' => $request->address,
            'province' => $request->province,
            'user_type' => $request->user_type,
            'company_name' => $request->company_name,
            'phone' => $request->phone,
            'vat_number' => $request->vat_number,
            'password' => Hash::make($request->password),
        ]);

        event(new Registered($user));

        // associate user to category
        $selectedCategory = UserCategory::where('code', $data['user_type'])->first();
        if (!$selectedCategory) {
            abort(400);
        }
        $user->categories()->save($selectedCategory);

        // we do not login user, as it will be requested to verify email before being able to login
        //Auth::login($user);

        return redirect(route('register.success'))->with(['status' => 1]);
    }


    /**
     * Shwo confirmation page
     */
    public function success()
    {
        if (session('status') !== 1) {
            return redirect('register');
        }

        return view('auth.register', [
            'response' => __('register.msg_success')
        ]);
    }
}

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\UserCategory;
use Illuminate\Auth\Events\Registered;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class RegisteredUserController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display the registration view.
     */
    public function create(): View
    {
        return view('auth.register');
    }

    /**
     * Handle an incoming registration request.
     *
     * @throws \Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException
     */
    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'firstname' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'lastname' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'email' => ['required', 'string', 'email', 'max:255', 'unique:'.User::class],
            'city' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'zip_code' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'address' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'province' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'user_type' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'company_name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'phone' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'vat_number' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'password' => ['required', 'confirmed', Password::defaults()],
        ], [], [
            'firstname' => __('validation.attributes.first_name'),
            'lastname' => __('validation.attributes.last_name'),
            'zip_code' => __('Zip / Postal Code'),
            'province' => __('validation.attributes.province'),
            'user_type' => __('form.label_user_type'),
            'vat_number' => __('VAT Number'),
        ]);

        $user = User::create([
            'firstname' => $request->firstname,
            'lastname' => $request->lastname,
            'email' => $request->email,
            'city' => $request->city,
            'zip_code' => $request->zip_code,
            'address' => $request->address,
            'province' => $request->province,
            'user_type' => $request->user_type,
            'company_name' => $request->company_name,
            'phone' => $request->phone,
            'vat_number' => $request->vat_number,
            'password' => Hash::make($request->password),
        ]);

        event(new Registered($user));

        // associate user to category
        $selectedCategory = UserCategory::where('code', $data['user_type'])->first();
        if (!$selectedCategory) {
            abort(400);
        }
        $user->categories()->save($selectedCategory);

        // we do not login user, as it will be requested to verify email before being able to login
        //Auth::login($user);

        return redirect(route('register.success'))->with(['status' => 1]);
    }


    /**
     * Shwo confirmation page
     */
    public function success()
    {
        if (session('status') !== 1) {
            return redirect('register');
        }

        return view('auth.register', [
            'response' => __('register.msg_success')
        ]);
    }
}
